Definition: from G3844 and G1325; to surrender, i.e yield up, intrust, transmit:--betray, bring forth, cast, commit, deliver (up), give (over, up), hazard, put in prison, recommend.
BiblicalUsage: Paradidōmi is to deliver up, to surrender, to hand over. God spared not His own Son but delivered Him up for us all; Paul delivers what he received, that the Lord Jesus the same night in which He was betrayed took bread; Jesus bows His head and gives up the ghost; and Judas asks what they will give him to deliver Jesus unto them.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this word holds the cross from every side. The Father delivers up the Son, the Son gives up His spirit, Judas hands Him over for silver, and Paul hands on what he received.
